message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for the facts.

Facts: Party secretary of a village, using position to accept bribes from a real estate developer's representative. Amount total 470,000 RMB. So it's bribery (受贿). Since the defendant is a public official (village party secretary) i.e., a state functionary. So the charge is "受贿". Not "非国家工作人员受贿" because he is a state functionary (party secretary). So "受贿". Also maybe "滥用职权"? The facts only mention receiving bribes, not abusing power. The charge likely just "受贿". In similar examples, they used "受贿" for officials receiving bribes. So answer: [罪名]受贿<eoa>.

Check if any other charge like "单位行贿" not applicable. So single charge.
